16_generalization_rule.text: INTEROP-002 cannot by itself change WEXP Core, the EMILIA specification, or the generic Prototype-000 core. Any apparently reusable finding is labelled CANDIDATE_GENERIC only; promotion requires a separate Founder decision, reproduction with at least one non-EMILIA external system, and a change process independent of the INTEROP-002 publication decision. A third exemplar inside the WEXP × EMILIA line is not external replication by itself.

immutability_rule.statement: After this freeze, the frozen design surface MUST NOT be modified in response to future bridge implementation results, a future B-01 reveal, future execution results, or any outcome whether favorable or unfavorable.
immutability_rule.why: A design surface that can move after seeing the result is not a prediction. The whole evidential value of freezing before bridge authoring is that the surface could not have been chosen to suit what came back.
any_necessary_change_requires: a new explicit successor design-freeze decision
the prior freeze preserved intact, not overwritten
a new experiment identity, or an equivalent treatment that is non-retroactive on its face
immutability_rule.prohibited: No silent repair under this freeze identity. Editing a frozen item without a successor decision does not produce a corrected experiment; it produces an experiment whose record cannot be trusted.
immutability_rule.charter_basis: DRAFT-004 §9.1: a change to any bound item invalidates the Design Freeze and requires an explicitly identified successor, not a silent edit.
immutability_rule.verification: Every bound item above carries a digest. Any later divergence is detectable by re-measurement, not by inspection or memory.

not_authorized_by_this_freeze.rule: design_frozen true implies none of the above. It means the design surface is fixed, nothing more. Each item remains its own decision with its own gate.

what_this_freeze_does_not_establish: It does not establish that the frozen design is correct, sufficient, or minimal. Those are what the experiment is for.
It does not establish any WEXP or EMILIA claim. CC-1 is the claim the experiment will attempt, not a claim it has made.
It does not make the pinned authorities endorsed, adopted, or standardized.
It does not make any hosted identity an execution authority; §9.2.1 binds those, and no such manifest exists.
